personality_one_liner: A vibrant, trustworthy, and food-forward platform that balances consumer appetite with operational clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets and breathing room for scrolling lists. Minimum 56pt tappable height. Ensure ample bottom padding for screens with sticky bottom CTA banners.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar.
Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling restaurant menus.
Use glass on Floating Action Buttons (like Chat per order).
dont's: Never blur body content or list rows.

screens.name: Customer Home
screens.purpose: Discover stores, access favorites, and view horizontal categories.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for restaurant cards with generic food shapes.
states.empty: No restaurants found for current address. CTA to change address.
states.error: Failed to load feed. Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header (glass) with location selector. Search bar. Horizontal scroll for categories (Burgers, Pizza, etc.). Vertical list of restaurant cards. Each card must have a hero image, title, rating, and delivery time.

screens.name: Store Detail (Menu)
screens.purpose: View store items, variations, and add to cart.

states.empty: Store has no items available right now.
states.error: Could not load menu. Retry button.

screens.layout: Hero image cover taking top 25%. Glassmorphism back button. Scrolling list of products grouped by category. Sticky bottom banner when items are in the cart showing total and 'View Cart' CTA.

screens.name: Checkout & Order Tracking
screens.purpose: Finalize payment and track real-time delivery status.
screens.layout: Checkout: Address selector, Payment method tiles (Pix, Card, Money). Tracking: Order status timeline (AGUARDANDO_CONFIRMACAO, ACEITO, EM_PREPARO, SAIU_PARA_ENTREGA, FINALIZADO) using status colors. Illustration of delivery rider. FAB for chat.

screens.name: Lojista Dashboard
screens.purpose: Store owner overview of analytics and active queue.
screens.layout: Top metric cards (Revenue, Orders). Order queue split by status. Swipeable list items to quickly change order status (e.g., swipe right to mark EM_PREPARO). Bottom tabs specifically for Lojista.

screens.name: Lojista Products CRUD

states.empty: No products added yet. Large primary CTA 'Add First Product'.

screens.layout: List view of products with thumbnail, price, and active toggle. Floating Action Button to add new product. Bottom sheet for editing add-ons.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.purpose: Manage user details, toggle roles, view subscription or loyalty program.
screens.layout: Avatar and user name. Distinct, highlighted toggle 'Switch to Lojista/Customer'. Section for ZappyFood Loyalty (points) or Lojista Subscription (R$99/month, 7-day trial). Standard list rows with chevrons.

abstract_orange.alt: Abstract clean orange background for Splash/Lojista Hero

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement navigation using expo-router, ensuring a smooth role switcher that seamlessly changes the bottom tabs from 'Customer' (Home, Search, Orders, Profile) to 'Lojista' (Dashboard, Products, Queue, Settings).
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Ensure stroke weight consistency across the app. Use outlined for inactive tabs, filled for active tabs.
For the Store Detail menu screen, make the top cover image parralax with scroll, and ensure a gradient scrim overlays the image to protect the white glass back button and any overlaid text.
Ensure 'brandPrimary' (#FF5A00) is used primarily for call-to-actions, active states, and important highlights, avoiding overusing it as large background blocks outside of the Splash screen.
Render the Order Status Timeline carefully using a vertical progress tracker. Ensure you use the semantic status colors (warning for EM_PREPARO, success for FINALIZADO).
When displaying photos on Customer cards (e.g., Pizza, Burgers), always apply an expo-image with a subtle gray background skeleton so it looks premium while loading.
